tasks.title: Prepare LAN browsing discovery implementation slice
tasks.summary: Add bounded sparse UDP LAN advertisement and browsing discovery UX with low-info candidate handling.
notes: Implemented: `discover browse` listens for sparse UDP LAN datagrams with bounded timeout and reports unique/duplicate/ambiguous candidates.
Implemented: `discover advertise --profile <path>` requires a valid low-info profile and emits only service, protocol, ephemeral nonce, and capability flags.
Preserved: top-level `discover --address` remains untrusted explicit-address hint compatibility.
Non-goal: pairing trust, daemon lifecycle, managed background advertisement, or continuous sync implementation in this feature.
